statement: Find a cyclic stabilizer code on n=5 qubits encoding k=1 logical qubit with the largest possible distance d. The stabilizer group is generated by the 5 cyclic shifts of a single Pauli string (the seed) over I,X,Y,Z.

candidate_format.generators: the n cyclic shifts of seed (filled automatically)

upper_bound.source: Quantum Singleton bound n-k >= 2(d-1) (Knill & Laflamme 1997); applies to all stabilizer codes

known_best.source: [[5,1,3]] perfect code (Laflamme et al. 1996; Bennett et al. 1996); optimal by the quantum Singleton bound

references: M. Grassl, Bounds on the minimum distance of quantum codes, codetables.de
Calderbank, Rains, Shor, Sloane, Quantum error correction via codes over GF(4), IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 44 (1998)
